as_told.title: Reverse engineering of a laser weapon from a downed Russian NHI spaceship

plain: Someone, unnamed in the tellings, is said to have worked on reverse engineering a laser weapon system taken from a downed Russian object. Reverse engineering here means taking a captured device apart to learn how it works and how to build it. Michels puts it this way on a 2026 episode with the journalist Jeremy Corbell, calling the object a "downed Russian asset." Corbell, who says he draws on named sources, goes further: he says the laser came from a downed Russian "NHI spaceship," NHI meaning non-human intelligence. If Corbell's version were true, Russia would have had its own crashed craft from non-human makers, and the US would have studied technology taken from it.
